need: The Nivo AgentOS module journey must ship Support Desk, Finance Copilot, Scheduling AI and Knowledge Hub as real registry-backed module kinds with the shared shell, one resumable Setup chat, kind workbench, credential Settings and deterministic data-mount-backed proof installations.
negativeBoundary: Do not replace the journey with frontend-only mock cards, remove custom-module capability, write credentials into source or .gitmounts, close the registry enum, or render arbitrary HTML, scripts or raw JSX outside Grammar contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: One proof workspace exposes exactly two installations of each initial kind and eight initial-kind installations total.
Every installation resumes exactly one private Setup chat and uses zero-to-many Execute sessions without rewriting prior context bindings.
Support Desk, Finance Copilot, Scheduling AI and Knowledge Hub resolve distinct trusted workbenches inside the same persistent module shell.
Nivo-owned public-safe manifests and bootstrap knowledge originate in the versioned data mount and idempotently seed database state.
Kind-declared credentials are entered in module Settings, stored write-only and encrypted, and returned only as masked configured status.
Signed-in responsive browser proof covers Setup, Execute, workbench, Settings credential entry and diagnostics for the initial kinds.

accepts: The four screenshot-backed initial kinds share one persistent shell while retaining distinct workbenches.
Custom-module capability remains available for later work but is excluded from the eight-installation seed set.
Each installation has a private resumable Setup chat and a Settings input for write-only credentials.
The simple Nivo bootstrap knowledge is generated as public-safe versioned operational data.
rejects: A frontend-only mock catalogue or hard-coded page state without persisted module identities.
Deleting the existing custom-module contracts or treating the initial four kinds as a closed core enum.
Persisting provider tokens in source, fixtures, browser-visible responses or the data mount.
Seeding fewer or more than two instances per initial kind in the selected proof workspace.
